onboarding.title: Crisper
onboarding.lede: Snap the receipt. We'll tell you what needs eating.
onboarding.question: Want to name your fridge?
onboarding.footnote: No email, no password. This browser stays signed in for ten years.

today.empty_body: Next time you shop, point the camera at the receipt.

capture.title: What did you get?
capture.camera_hint: Receipt or the shopping itself — it works out which
capture.voice_hint: For when your hands are full
capture.review_lede: We got these. Tap anything that looks wrong later — nothing to confirm now.
capture.hard_to_read: That one was hard to read.
capture.unreadable: That one was hard to read. Want to try again, or just tell us the fresh stuff?
capture.no_camera: We couldn't open the camera. You can type it instead.
capture.no_mic: We couldn't hear anything. You can type it instead.

shutter.searching: Point at the receipt or the shopping
shutter.too_dark: A bit dark — move to the light

install.title: Add to your home screen
install.pitch: Add Crisper to your home screen — it opens straight to the camera.
install.ios_steps: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.unavailable: Your browser will offer this once you've used the app a couple of times.

settings.title: You
settings.identity_note: Kept in this browser and in a ten-year cookie. Clearing both loses the fridge — one receipt rebuilds it.
settings.stub_mode: Running offline with sample data — no API key set, so nothing has been billed.
settings.forget_note: Deletes everything we hold for this fridge. There is no undo.
